scope: training-only retrieval recalibration; no LLM calls; no held-out access
research_question: Can a deterministically configured adaptive single-view retriever preserve retrieval quality while improving actual context efficiency relative to declared fixed-k and shallow-probe comparators?

hypotheses.H1_retrieval: At least one preregistered single-view operating point improves unique gold-span recall by >=0.02 over the shallow-probe comparator.
hypotheses.H2_efficiency: At recall noninferiority margin -0.02, adaptive retrieval reduces mean actual context tokens by >=10% relative to a fixed-k comparator at the same safety maximum.
hypotheses.H3_answerable_CER: The selected method improves answerable-only complete-evidence recovery by >=0.03 over the shallow-probe comparator.
hypotheses.null_safe: If neither quality nor efficiency criteria are met, the method is reported as Pareto competitive or unsupported; no superiority claim is permitted.

design_exposed.definition: Every example ID discoverable in prior calibration, pilot, screening, diagnostic, analysis, or normalized-sample artifacts at freeze time.
design_exposed.use: method design only; excluded from v2 tuning and selection

partitions.development_population: Official QASPER train and MuSiQue-Full train only, after all exclusions.
partitions.v2_tuning: 18 examples per stratum (162 total), assigned by deterministic within-stratum hash; fits relevance threshold and patience.
partitions.v2_selection: 7 examples per stratum (63 total), assigned before execution; used once by the frozen selection rule.

locked: MuSiQue-Full official development/validation for locally scored confirmation
MuSiQue-Full official test for hidden-label submission only
final_held_out.id_disjointness: v2 IDs must contain the literal split tag ':train:'; QASPER test IDs contain ':test:', proving structural disjointness without opening test records.

include: at least one gold evidence span
exclude: QASPER insufficient questions with zero gold evidence spans
inclusion_exclusion.insufficient: MuSiQue insufficient examples with residual gold support are included; residual-support complete recovery is secondary and never mixed with answerable CER

embedding.implementation: Hugging Face Transformers/SentenceTransformers-compatible local snapshot; L2-normalized mean pooling

primary_method.deduplication: after adaptive retrieval and before final context accounting/output; efficiency mechanism only
primary_method.final_k: emergent; never selected or fixed as a tuning parameter
primary_method.llm_policy: zero LLM calls during selection, retrieval, tuning, or this recalibration; Groq is permitted only for a separately authorized final answer call

primary: unique gold-span recall over all evidence-scored questions
answer token F1 only after paid authorization
secondary: residual-support complete recovery for insufficient questions

requirements: same answer model and prompt in any paid phase
fair_comparison.matched_actual_tokens: mean context tokens within 10% on identical queries; paired token differences also reported
fair_comparison.no_full_budget_requirement: adaptive systems need not consume the 2,000-token safety maximum

inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction across declared primary comparisons within each primary metric

frozen_selection_rule.tuning_stage: For each representation and token point, retain the parameter tuple with highest tuning recall; treat differences <=0.01 as tied, then maximize answerable CER, minimize actual tokens, minimize candidates, and use canonical tuple order as final tie-break.
frozen_selection_rule.selection_stage: Evaluate only the 12 tuning-selected representation/token candidates. Shortlist candidates within 0.01 of the highest selection recall; then maximize answerable CER, minimize actual tokens, minimize candidates, and break exact ties by the preregistered representation order [semantic, paragraph, hierarchical_v2, sentence_window] followed by ascending token point.
frozen_selection_rule.prior_screening_guard: The representation order is only an exact tie-break. Semantic receives no score bonus and is not selected merely because it led the design-exposed screening sample.

classification.better_on_retrieval_quality: recall gain >=0.02 with Holm-adjusted p<0.05, or answerable CER gain >=0.03 with adjusted p<0.05, versus the declared comparator
classification.better_only_on_efficiency: recall lower CI >=-0.02 and context reduction >=10% with paired token p<0.05, without a quality win
classification.pareto_competitive: non-dominated in recall versus actual-token space but neither superiority rule passes
classification.unsupported: dominated or fails both noninferiority and quality criteria

comparators: probe-only k=3 for the same representation

run_integrity.resume: append-only per-example output; reject if protocol, configuration, embedding, input, sample, seed, or code fingerprint differs; never mix configurations
run_integrity.failed_runs: record failure row and retry count; deterministic retry only under identical fingerprints; otherwise start a new versioned run directory

paid_smoke_test_gate.condition: All retrieval-only v2 artifacts complete; full tests pass; frozen manifest reproduces exactly; overlap audit is zero; no unresolved failures; answer prompt/model fingerprints are frozen; user gives explicit paid-run authorization with a call ceiling and cost ceiling.
paid_smoke_test_gate.data: design-exposed training examples only; never final held-out records

final_held_out_gate.condition: Paid smoke passes without method changes; all protocol/manifest/code/prompt/model hashes remain frozen; exact run cost and resume plan are recorded; user gives a separate explicit authorization for final held-out evaluation.
final_held_out_gate.after_access: No tuning, selection, threshold, representation, prompt, or analysis-rule changes are allowed; deviations require a new protocol and the accessed examples remain exposed.
